meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 启用后,Claude 会把 NanoClaw 的凭证改成从 .env 文件读取,并注入容器环境变量,不再走 OneCLI 网关;只在 .env 里把 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS 设为 true 时才生效。
howto.when: 当你要求绕开 OneCLI 网关、改用 .env 文件提供 Anthropic 凭证(API 密钥或订阅令牌)时触发。

say.text: 帮我改用 .env 文件配置 Anthropic 凭证,不用 OneCLI。
把 NanoClaw 的 API 密钥改为从 .env 读取并注入容器。
say.note: 它会设置开关并写入 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY。

say.text: 我要用 Claude 订阅令牌,绕开 OneCLI 网关。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude switches NanoClaw to read Anthropic credentials from a .env file and inject them into the container env, bypassing the OneCLI gateway. It only takes effect when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to bypass the OneCLI gateway and use a .env file for Anthropic credentials (API key or subscription token).

say_en.text: Help me configure Anthropic credentials from .env instead of OneCLI.
say_en.note: Claude will apply the proxy and guide you through .env setup.

say_en.text: Switch NanoClaw to read the API key from .env and inject it into the container.
say_en.note: It sets the flag and writes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

say_en.text: I want to use my Claude subscription token, skipping OneCLI.
say_en.note: Claude will walk you through claude setup-token and .env update.
